_note: Every patient-facing string in the system. Copy to ar.json and translate to switch language; no string is ever hardcoded in Python.
greeting: Hello. Tell me what's worrying you, in your own words, and I'll help you understand it and find the right doctor.
disclaimer: I don't diagnose and I don't prescribe. I help you organise what's going on and point you to a doctor we've checked ourselves.
escalate.emergency.title: Please get emergency care now.
escalate.emergency.body: What you've described needs to be seen straight away. Go to the nearest hospital emergency department now. If you can't get there safely, call 123 for an ambulance. Please don't drive yourself.
escalate.emergency.footer: I've stopped here on purpose. This isn't something to book an appointment for.
ask.fallback: Can you tell me a little more about that?
complete.title: Thank you. I have what I need.
complete.body: I've put together a summary of what you've told me. Here are the doctors I'd suggest.
complete.urgent_note: Some of what you've described should be looked at soon rather than left. I've marked your summary accordingly.
routing.suggested: Based on what you've described, the right specialty looks like {specialty}.
shortlist.title: Doctors we've checked
shortlist.empty: I don't have a vetted doctor in that specialty yet. I'd rather tell you that than send you to someone we haven't checked.
shortlist.why_short: This list is short on purpose. We only show doctors we've verified ourselves, and no one can pay to appear here.
booking.confirmed: You're booked with {doctor} on {slot}. They'll open your summary before you arrive, so you won't have to start from the beginning.
selfcare.generic: From what you've described, this can often be managed at home to begin with. Rest, drink fluids, and keep an eye on how it changes.
selfcare.safety_net: Please see a doctor if it gets worse, if it hasn't started improving within {days} days, or if anything new appears that worries you.
error.unreviewed_flags: This system's emergency criteria have not yet been reviewed by a doctor. It must not be used with real patients until they are.
